Backend 5/5 pytest PASS (flat pricing 170 000 FCFA for pkg_std 50k + pkg_bal 120k, max_persons 400, unknown package_id 400, non-regression classical pricing, mixed adults+children participants accepted). ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. ReferenceError 'Cannot access usesPackages before initialization' — const declared at line ~271 but consumed in useEffect deps array on line 180 → TDZ crash on every /booking/special-event/* render (white Uncaught runtime errors overlay, entire Step 3 unreachable). Patch: hoisted `const usesPackages = isSpecialEvent && packageSelections.length > 0;` to right after `useState([])` for packageSelections, and removed the duplicate declaration further down. Verified — booking tunnel now renders Step 3 cleanly.

rca of the issue: Root cause: BookingTunnel.jsx had `const usesPackages = ...` declared on line 271 but the dependency array `[adults, children, usesPackages]` on line 180 evaluated `usesPackages` synchronously during render — before the const initializer ran. Because JS `const` lives in a Temporal Dead Zone until its declaration line executes, every render of BookingTunnel threw `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'usesPackages' before initialization`. The crash was masked during smoke-testing because the agent reportedly tested the EventDetail step only and never opened the booking tunnel route directly. Mitigation applied: moved the declaration immediately after `const [packageSelections, setPackageSelections] = useState([]);` on line 42, and removed the now-duplicate declaration. Verified post-fix: /booking/special-event/<id>?date=2026-12-15 renders Step 3 only with all 6 participant rows when pkg_std (max_persons=6) is active.
